newsitem.title: UK: UK parliament speaker pays tribute to HK.
newsitem.headline: UK parliament speaker pays tribute to HK.

text.p: The speaker of Britain's parliament, Betty Boothroyd, wished Hong Kong well on Monday and paid special tribute to its legislative council.

"I know that the thoughts of this House are of course with the people of Hong Kong, particularly today, and we certainly wish them success and all happiness in the future," Boothroyd told the House of Commons as Big Ben chimed to mark the final 30 minutes of British colonial rule of Hong Kong.
"May I just pay my own personal tribute to the work of the elected Legislative Council, which I had the pleasure of visiting a couple of years ago?
"Just let me say from this democratic institution, which is often known as the mother of parliaments, our thoughts go to Hong Kong and our best wishes for the future," she said.
Shortly after the midnight handover to China, a Beijing-appointed provisional legislature will be sworn in to replace the legislative council.
